svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: var(--ge-adaptive-bg, #ffffff); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="K_ZTr44DlPa_CnjdC5Np"> <mxGraphModel dx="1426" dy="136" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{"data":"@startuml
title Application-Level Sequence Diagram

autonumber

participant \"Traffic Perception\n& Acquisition\" as Vision
queue \"Snapshot Queue\" as SnapQ
participant \"Traffic Timing\nDecision\" as Decision
participant \"Traffic Signal\nController (FSM)\" as FSM
participant \"Analytics\nService\" as Analytics
actor \"Manager\" as Manager
actor \"Traffic Participant\" as User

activate Vision

note right of Vision
- Capture camera frames
- Inference traffic frames
- Detect vehicles
- Estimate traffic metrics
end note



alt Vision operating normally

 Vision ->> SnapQ : publishTrafficSnapshot()
activate SnapQ
 Vision ->> Manager : Display multi-lane view
 activate Manager
 deactivate Vision
 
 deactivate Manager

else Vision error
 Vision ->> Manager : Report error
 activate Vision
 activate Manager
 deactivate Vision
 deactivate Manager

end




Decision -> SnapQ : SnapshotRequest()
activate Decision
SnapQ -->> Decision : TrafficSnapshot
deactivate SnapQ

note right of Decision
- Validate snapshot 
- Detect emergency requests
- Estimate traffic demand
- Generate TimingPlan
- And publish TimingPlan
end note

Decision -> FSM : publishTimingPlan()

activate FSM

FSM -->> Decision : ACK / NACK
deactivate Decision

note right of FSM
- Execute TimingPlan from Plan Receiver
- Control signal phases (RED/YELLOW/GREEN)
- Handle emergency preemption
- Collect execution timestamp
- Simulate signal display output
end note 
FSM -> User : Traffic signal states
activate User

FSM -> Analytics : publishExecutionStatistics()

deactivate FSM


activate Analytics

note right of Analytics
- Analyze signal timing 
- Present dashboard insights to manager 
- Trigger alerts on threshold violation
- Generate performance reports
end note

Analytics -> Manager : Dashboard / Reports / Alerts
deactivate Analytics
activate Manager
deactivate Manager
deactivate User


@enduml","format":"svg"}" id="9FkAYh4zOH2huxU83_XE-1"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="928" width="1225" x="20" y="1020" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
